result.question: Start McBride or Brock Bowers?
result.answer: Start Brock Bowers over Trey McBride. Bowers holds a head-to-head PPR advantage, averaging 20.6 points per game to McBride's 17.2, and 18.2 to McBride's 14.7 over the later weeks. Despite McBride's easier defensive matchup, Bowers's higher weekly production and consistent 10.8-target workload make him the stronger start.

claims.text: Brock Bowers: LV, TE, roster status ACT (week 7). Trey McBride: ARI, TE, roster status ACT (week 7).

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND LOWER(full_name) IN ('trey mcbride', 'start mcbride', 'mcbride or', 'or brock', 'brock bowers', 'start mcbride or', 'mcbride or brock', 'or brock bowers') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Bowers averages 20.6 PPR points per game on 10.8 targets, while McBride averages 17.2 PPR points per game on 10.8 targets, giving Bowers a 3.4-point weekly advantage.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, ps.week, ps.opponent_team, ROUND(100 * sc.offense_pct, 1) AS snap_pct, ps.targets, ROUND(100 * ps.target_share, 1) AS target_share_pct, ps.receptions, ps.carries, ROUND(ps.fantasy_points_ppr, 1) AS ppr_points FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN NFLVERSE.snap_counts sc ON sc.game_id = ps.game_id AND sc.player = ps.player_display_name AND sc.team = ps.team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') ORDER BY ps.player_display_name, ps.week

claims.text: McBride faces a significantly easier matchup, with DEN allowing 13.2 PPR to TEs (rank 15) compared to LA's 8.3 PPR allowed (rank 31) for Bowers.

evidence.sql: WITH players AS (SELECT '00-0037744' AS player_id, 'Trey McBride' AS player, 'ARI' AS team, 'TE' AS position UNION ALL SELECT '00-0039338' AS player_id, 'Brock Bowers' AS player, 'LV' AS team, 'TE' AS position), games AS (SELECT home_team AS team, away_team AS opponent, week, home_score FROM NFLVERSE.schedules WHERE season = 2026 UNION ALL SELECT away_team AS team, home_team AS opponent, week, home_score FROM NFLVERSE.schedules WHERE season = 2026), target AS (SELECT team, MIN(week) AS week FROM games WHERE week > 6 GROUP BY team), allowed AS (SELECT opponent_team, position, week, SUM(fantasy_points_ppr) AS pts FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats WHERE season = 2026 GROUP BY opponent_team, position, week), avg_allowed AS (SELECT opponent_team, position, ROUND(AVG(pts), 1) AS avg_ppr_allowed, COUNT(*) AS opp_games FROM allowed GROUP BY opponent_team, position), ranked AS (SELECT opponent_team, position, avg_ppr_allowed, opp_games, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY position ORDER BY avg_ppr_allowed DESC) AS allowed_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY position) AS teams_ranked FROM avg_allowed) SELECT p.player, p.team, p.position, t.week AS game_week, g.opponent, CASE WHEN g.home_score IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS played, r.avg_ppr_allowed AS opp_avg_ppr_allowed, r.allowed_rank, r.teams_ranked, r.opp_games FROM players p LEFT JOIN target t ON t.team = p.team LEFT JOIN games g ON g.team = p.team AND g.week = t.week LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.opponent_team = g.opponent AND r.position = p.position ORDER BY p.player

claims.text: McBride has a 0.4% higher average target share (29.7% vs 29.3%) and a 10.1% lower average air yards share (23.8% vs 33.9%), indicating greater red-zone involvement per target.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, ps.team, COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(ps.targets) AS targets, ROUND(100 * AVG(ps.target_share), 1) AS avg_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(ps.air_yards_share), 1) AS avg_air_yards_share_pct, SUM(ps.carries) AS carries, ROUND(AVG(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 1) AS ppr_per_game FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name, ps.team ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Brock Bowers averaged 27.6 PPR points per game in weeks 1-3 compared to Trey McBride's 19.7, but Bowers's target share dropped from 43.3% to 24.6% while McBride's declined only from 31.9% to 27.5%.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, 3 AS split_week, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_games, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS early_ppr_per_game, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS late_ppr_per_game, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS early_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS late_target_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: McBride's 17.5% touchdown share is lower than Bowers's 21.9%, making him less touchdown-dependent for PPR points.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS touchdowns, 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS td_points, ROUND(SUM(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 1) AS ppr_points, ROUND(100 * 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) / NULLIF(SUM(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 0), 1) AS td_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

McBride's more stable recent form and better defensive matchup make him the stronger start for week 7.
